title: AudioFormatConverter media catalog batch
description: A generated JSON scan batch containing album folders and loss-aware per-file metadata records.
$comment: Schema v2 uses TagLib for native tag reading and linked FFmpeg libraries for container properties/chapters and optional decode analysis. Keep rawTags for source-scoped values and tags for searchable normalized multi-values. Missing technical values are unknown, not zero. Catalog, integrity and analysis are distinct scan tiers.

album.description: A discovered directory containing one or more accepted audio files.

Album Path.description: Absolute source directory path used for display and duplicate-folder navigation.

Library Root.description: Absolute source library root; combined with album-relative file paths for stable database identity.

Folder.description: Directory leaf name; descriptive only and not a stable identifier.

diagnostics.description: Album-level scan diagnostics. File-level diagnostics belong to the matching track record.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this per-file catalog record, independent of the database schema version.

relativePath.description: Path of the audio file relative to its album directory.

sizeBytes.description: Filesystem size; this is not the encoded audio payload size.

modifiedUtc.description: Filesystem modification time when available; it is not a content identity.

format.description: Container format name reported by the linked FFmpeg libraries.

technical.description: Observed technical properties. Omitted values were unavailable from the reader.

flacMd5.description: FLAC stream-declared PCM MD5, not a file hash or independent verification.

tags.description: Normalized searchable tags. Every key maps to an array because tags can repeat.

rawTags.description: TagLib-exposed native tag entries, retaining tag scope, key, extraction ordinal, and frame qualifiers where available. Ordinals are not guaranteed to match on-disk ordering for map-based formats.

ordinal.description: Order in which the reader enumerated the entry; not necessarily original on-disk order.

pictures.description: Embedded picture descriptors; image bytes are not duplicated into catalog JSON.

chapters.description: Container-level chapter boundaries and chapter tags when exposed by FFmpeg libraries.

integrity.description: Optional full-decode checks. Status not_run means no decode was attempted; it is not a pass.

status.description: Integrity tier result, separate from tag extraction.
status.$comment: Decode errors do not erase successfully extracted metadata.
status.x-ai-hint: Only status=ok means every requested integrity check passed. not_run is not evidence of a clean file.

decodedSamples.description: Decoded samples per channel, not total interleaved scalar values.
decodedSamples.$comment: Compare with FLAC STREAMINFO total samples when available.
decodedSamples.x-ai-hint: This is a decoder observation; use it to detect truncation when compared with declared totalSamples.

firstErrorPosition.description: First known byte offset or packet timestamp associated with a decode failure.
firstErrorPosition.x-ai-hint: The value is decoder/container-relative evidence, not necessarily a precise corrupt-byte location.

flacMd5Matches.description: Whether decoded integer PCM matched a nonzero FLAC STREAMINFO MD5.
flacMd5Matches.x-ai-hint: Absent means the source MD5 was missing, zero/unset, or unsupported; it is not a pass.

fileSha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete source file.
fileSha256.x-ai-hint: Changes when tags or container metadata change.

pcmSha256.description: SHA-256 of interleaved decoded sample bytes as emitted by the selected decoder.
pcmSha256.x-ai-hint: Useful for comparing retagged copies in the same decoder environment; not a universal codec-independent PCM fingerprint.

findings.description: Explicit validation and heuristic findings; absence of a finding is not proof of quality.

items.x-ai-hint: Treat each finding as evidence-backed and heuristic where applicable; confidence is not certainty.

diagnostics.description: Extraction, probing, decode, and serialization diagnostics linked to this file record.

tags.description: Whether TagLib exposed a metadata tag interface for the file.

nativeInventory.description: Whether every native metadata block/frame was enumerated; partial is not lossless.

decode.description: Full audio decode status. Metadata probing alone must remain not_run.

chapters.description: Whether chapter metadata is read using the linked FFmpeg libraries.

status.description: Do not interpret missing measurements as a zero-valued result.
status.x-ai-hint: partial means some optional analysis is not measured or unavailable; consult each measurement.

tier.x-ai-hint: Catalog records contain tags only; integrity and analysis tiers perform a full decode.

measurements.description: Method-specific measured signal values; units are encoded in each field name.
measurements.x-ai-hint: These are measured from decoded audio, unlike tags such as ReplayGain which are claims.

method.description: Analyzer/version used to derive the numeric measurements.

usedBits.description: Observed integer-sample precision after accounting for decoder left-shift.
usedBits.x-ai-hint: This detects zero-padded low bits only; it is not effective resolution or proof of genuine high-resolution mastering.

usedBitsStatus.x-ai-hint: Float/lossy formats are unsupported; silence yields unavailable rather than a fabricated bit depth.

error.description: Reader diagnostic when the record is retained despite incomplete extraction.
